vibe_rationale: Genuine overland community camping on site, but a large gear-led expo with a trade-show feel and heavy sponsor branding.
fit_notes: Large outdoor-adventure audience (age not published) camping for three days in the high desert, with hydration, sun and recovery products fitting the setting. Seventy-seven listed partners, a partnership page and contact email, and the exhibitor model already welcomes non-endemic brands. Commercial in feel, and US-based.
